BiblicalUsage: Read sâchâh as to swim; causatively, to inundate. It stands in Isaiah 25:11, "…shall spread forth his hands in the midst…", and in Psalms 6:6, "…am weary with my groaning; all the night…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sâchâh counts, because God put it in his book.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
